name: 088.1 — :list() enumerates, and nothing else
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 088.1: hafen.ui():list() raises naming :listbox() and builds nothing, hafen.ui():listbox() builds a real one that answers :rowHeight(20) and :rows{...} and still refuses an argument, hafen.vr():entity() is a collection whose :count() equals the sum of the four per-kind counts and whose :remove(x) ends a ghost, hafen.vr():click(...) answers a boolean, and hafen.vr():list() and hafen.vr():pointer(...) each raise naming their replacement.
